title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.40
summary: Reliable update notices after many releases, with all recent browsing and next-series improvements.

sections.heading: Keep future update notices working
bullets: Old archived release notes retire automatically when their file reaches its size limit. Current update notices and your notification preferences stay saved.

sections.heading: Clearer next-series actions
bullets: The selected show stays outlined and named while you browse it, read its synopsis or save it to My Stuff. Row customization remains in Settings.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Trakt recommendation rows, both icon packs, playback preferences, authorizations, saved data and unrelated add-ons remain in place.
